segments.text: Two files sit in the home directory, passwords dot old and passwords dot new, and the password for bandit eighteen is the single line that changed.
I log in as bandit17 with ssh bandit17@bandit.labs.overthewire.org -p 2220.
Diff compares two files line by line and prints only the differences, so I run diff on the two files.
There is exactly one hunk: line forty-two changed, the old value marked with a less-than sign, the new value with a greater-than sign.
The new side is the password for bandit eighteen, and the level is solved.
